plugin.name: Project2DFX
RenderLodLights.description: Street lamps and other lights glow far across the city at night, as on the console versions. Off: the game's own distant lights.
CoronaRadiusMultiplier.description: Multiplier of the size of the distant lights.
CoronaAlphaMultiplier.description: Multiplier of the brightness of the distant lights.
SlightlyIncreaseRadiusWithDistance.descr: Distant lights grow slightly with distance, so they stay visible far away.
DrawDistance.description: How far away distant lights are drawn. Auto: as far as the camera sees.
DisableDefaultLodLights.description: Hides the game's own distant lights while these are shown, so they don't appear twice.
